tasks.brief: Fix the delivery strand found by the J-1 diagnostic (verify1065/diag1065.mjs): after the hut is done, a founder who flips to rest/eat while carrying wood strands the delivery — Greta and Perrin carried 2 wood each for 115+ seconds without delivering (completed stuck at 17, pile stuck at 14).
